QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` is a rename, not an access control. ... `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`... the real name `state` is invisible to it.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says opacity comes from compile-time renaming of the member name via `private_##member`, with fields declared through the macro (so they still exist), not from hiding the layout.
